products.name: RAIN hooded jumper
products.summary: The RAIN 2026 hooded jumper: our mark on the chest and Joel 2:23 across the back.
products.description: Made for RAIN 2026. The Transformation Edge mark sits on the chest and RAIN runs down one sleeve. Across the back, RAIN in tall letters over “The former rain, and the latter rain”, with Joel 2:23 falling away beneath like rain. A pullover hood with drawcords, a front pouch pocket, and ribbed cuffs and hem.
products.careNotes: Wash cold and inside out, and do not iron over the print.
products.pictureNote: The pictures are design mockups. Colours on a screen can differ a little from the printed garment.

products.name: Do Not Bow
products.author: Dr Michaels Aibangbee
products.summary: Three young men on the plain of Dura, and the faith that would not bow.
products.description: Do Not Bow returns to the plain of Dura, where three young Hebrew men stood firm while an empire bowed. It traces a six-stage progression of compromise, names the cultural pressures that quietly pull believers away from wholehearted devotion to God, and calls readers to a “But if not” faith: loyalty to God even if deliverance never comes. The book launches on Sunday 15 November, the last day of RAIN 2026.
